a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve reaches 8, then take 4 each. The storm odds are brutal, but I won't grab cells early. I'll tell you honestly if anything changes, and I'm counting on you to do the same.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating this round as agreed. If we both operate, the reserve hits 6, and after one more round it reaches 8. Then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
